name: Notion 只读

configuration.label: Notion OAuth Client ID
configuration.description: Notion 集成设置中的 Client ID，不是凭据本身。

configuration.label: Notion OAuth Client Secret 引用
configuration.description: 只填写中央部署环境中的凭据引用，例如 ${MOTE_NOTION_CLIENT_SECRET}；不填写明文密钥。

configuration.label: Notion 回调地址
configuration.description: 必须与 Notion 集成设置中的 Redirect URI 完全一致，例如 https://central.example.com/oauth/notion/callback。

access: Owner-configured read-only Notion pages and databases selected in Sources
OAuth access token stays in host-bound instance state; the client secret is resolved from the central secret reference and never stored in the package or instance JSON
No Notion create, update, delete or append calls; no model calls; no workspace-wide scan

sourceCatalog.title: Notion（只读）
sourceCatalog.body: 只读归档已勾选的页面或数据库，按稳定身份保留版本
sourceCatalog.note: 安装不等于授权。完成配置与核验后，在来源中连接 Notion 并勾选页面或数据库。
